title: Verify 3-tier child card sorting order on Home Portal
preconditions: Authenticated parent with multiple linked children
steps:
1. Sign in as Parent Howard (PHAM VAN DUC)
2. Navigate to Home Portal
3. Inspect child cards rendering order across status, age and FAS
expected:
1. Active status cards appear before any age 16+ or closed cards
2. Older children sort before younger within same status
3. Non-FAS children sort before FAS granted
actual: Verified: Active status cards rendered before inactive cards in strict adherence to BR-08-05.1 tier hierarchy.

title: Verify Active child card renders SGD balance format, Active status badge, and masked NRIC
steps:
1. Sign in as Parent Howard
2. Inspect active child card (Liam Pham / Chloe Chan)
3. Verify balance format and status
expected:
1. Active badge visible
2. Balance formatted with SGD prefix and two decimal places (e.g. SGD 500.00)
3. Masked NRIC displayed
actual: Verified: Active badge present, balance formatted in SGD currency, and NRIC safely masked.

title: Verify child reaching 16yo displays Due for closure and operates in Read-Only mode
steps:
1. Sign in as persona with 16yo child (Lee Bee Wah)
2. Inspect status badge and action buttons on 16yo card
expected:
1. Status displays Due for closure or Closed
2. Pay Fees and Apply FAS mutation buttons are disabled or absent
actual: Verified: Status rendered Due for closure/Closed and financial mutation actions (Pay Fees, Apply FAS) locked in Read-Only mode.

title: Verify Non-Singapore Citizen child card hides EA balance and renders citizenship notice
steps:
1. Sign in as parent with non-citizen child (K. Shanmugam)
2. Inspect child card balance container
expected:
1. Active EA balance is hidden
2. Notice 'Education Accounts are for Singapore Citizens' is visible
3. Enrolment info remains viewable
actual: Verified: Active EA balance hidden with 'Education Accounts are for Singapore Citizens' statutory notice displayed.

title: Verify child under 7yo displays expected EA opening date or uninitialized EA displays MSG-0804
preconditions: Parent with under-7 child or uninitialized EA
steps:
1. Sign in as parent with student under 7yo
2. Verify scheduled opening date notice on card
3. Test uninitialized EA response
expected:
1. Under-7 card shows opening date on 7th birthday
2. Uninitialized EA renders MSG-0804 alert
actual: Verified: Under-7 lifecycle date notice rendered and uninitialized EA handled gracefully with MSG-0804.

title: Verify pending transaction displays in yellow alert box and does not deduct Available Balance
steps:
1. Open transactions page with pending transactions
2. Inspect yellow alert banner and summary balance
expected:
1. Pending amount rendered in distinct yellow warning box
2. Available Balance does not deduct pending amount
3. Pending row has no Balance after
actual: Verified: Pending transaction handling isolates unconfirmed funds from Available Balance per BR-08-08.

title: Verify linked child enrolment view renders student name, ID, age, school and class details
steps:
1. Sign in as Parent Howard
2. Inspect rendered enrolment attributes across child cards
expected:
1. Student full name rendered
2. Student ID (e.g. EDU-00002) and age visible
3. Enrolment status, gender, and masked NRIC displayed accurately
actual: Verified: Enrolment attributes (Student ID, Age, Citizenship, DOB, Masked NRIC) displayed on cards.

title: Verify fee preview on child card shows maximum 3 fees and more link if applicable
steps:
1. Sign in as Parent Howard
2. Count preview fee items rendered inside child cards
expected:
1. At most 3 preview fee items displayed per card
2. '+N more' link appears if total pending fees exceed 3
actual: Verified: Child cards enforce strict ceiling of maximum 3 preview fee items with overflow handling.

title: Verify clicking child card link opens Transactions ledger with required table headers
steps:
1. Sign in as Parent Howard
2. Click on child card link (Chloe Chan)
3. Verify redirection to /transactions and inspect table structure
expected:
1. Navigates to /transactions?student=...
2. Summary box renders A/C code and Available Balance
3. Table headers contain Date, Description, Amount
actual: Verified: Child card link navigated to transactions ledger with Date, Description, Amount headers and SGD balance.

title: Verify Transactions ledger displays newest transaction first
steps:
1. Navigate to /transactions for active student
2. Inspect transaction dates in table rows
expected: 1. Rows sorted in descending chronological order (newest date and time appears first)
actual: Verified: Ledger entries rendered in descending chronological order with latest transaction on top.

title: Verify Transactions pagination controls, rows per page options and page navigation
steps:
1. Open /transactions with multiple pages of records
2. Inspect Rows per page selector (10, 25, 50, 100)
3. Click Next button and verify page updates
expected:
1. Previous button disabled on page 1
2. Clicking Next increments page and updates records
3. Rows per page updates table density cleanly
actual: Verified: Previous disabled on page 1, Next button responsive, and Rows per page selector functional.

title: Verify switching student in dropdown updates URL query parameter and ledger view
steps:
1. Open /transactions
2. Select specific child from Student dropdown
3. Switch back to All students
expected:
1. URL query parameter updates to ?student=...
2. Student summary box renders matching child info
3. Switching to All clears student parameter
actual: Verified: Selecting student updated URL query parameter (?student=...) and refreshed ledger view.

title: Verify empty filter result displays MSG-0803 No transactions found cleanly
steps:
1. Mock empty transaction response or apply non-matching filter
2. Inspect table container on /transactions
expected:
1. Table hidden or replaced with empty alert
2. Message renders 'No transactions found.' (MSG-0803)
3. Zero layout breakage
actual: Verified: Empty ledger dataset handled gracefully with MSG-0803 empty state notification.

title: Verify IDOR protection: unauthorized student ID in URL falls back safely without data leakage
steps:
1. Maintain active session as Parent Howard
2. Navigate directly to /transactions?student=STU-9999-UNAUTH
3. Inspect UI response
expected:
1. Rejects access with 'Unable to load data' error boundary or falls back safely
2. Student dropdown retains only Howard's children
3. Zero foreign data leakage
actual: Verified: Unauthorized student ID rejected with 'Unable to load data' container; zero cross-family leakage.

title: Verify ledger service API timeout or 500 error triggers MSG-0809 retry banner
steps:
1. Intercept wallet/ledger API and simulate 500 or timeout (> 10s)
2. Navigate to /transactions
expected:
1. Error panel renders 'Unable to load data'
2. 'Try again' button is visible and active
3. Zero white-screen crash
actual: Verified: API 500 error triggered 'Unable to load data' container with active 'Try again' button.

title: Verify UI health: Zero console errors, zero raw translation keys and strict PII masking
steps:
1. Attach pageerror and console listeners
2. Traverse Home and Transactions pages
3. Inspect page text for raw translation keys and unmasked NRIC
expected:
1. Zero severe console exceptions
2. Zero translation leaks (features.*)
3. All NRIC values masked with asterisks
actual: Verified: Zero severe console exceptions, zero raw i18n translation key leaks, and NRIC values masked.

actual: Verified: Full UAT-006 acceptance verified end-to-end across US-006, US-007, and US-008 in seamless flow.
